---
title: "EVD Systems"
---

**A Global Library of Real-World EVD Systems** — browse how EVD systems vary across institutions worldwide. Click a region/category to expand it.

```{ojs}
systems = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  // Live listener — updates automatically whenever EVDSystems
  // changes in Firestore, no page reload needed.
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "EVDSystems"), snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Deterministic color per category name — same category always
// gets the same color, no manual mapping to maintain.
function categoryColor(name) {
  const palette = ["#2c7be5", "#27ae60", "#e67e22", "#8e44ad", "#e74c3c", "#16a2b8", "#d63384", "#6c757d"];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  return palette[Math.abs(hash) % palette.length];
}
```

```{ojs}
groupedSystems = {
  const groups = new Map();
  systems.forEach(s => {
    const key = s.category ?? "Uncategorized";
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(s);
  });
  return [...groups.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<div>
  ${groupedSystems.map(([category, items]) => {
    const color = categoryColor(category);
    return `
      <details class="fs-accordion">
        <summary class="fs-accordion-summary" style="background:${color};">
          <span class="fs-accordion-name">${category}</span>
          <span class="fs-accordion-count">${items.length}</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="fs-accordion-body">
          <div class="fs-grid" style="margin-top:12px;">
            ${items.map(s => `
              <div class="fs-card">
                <img class="fs-card-image" src="${s.imageURL ?? ""}" onerror="this.style.display='none'" onclick="fsOpenLightbox(this.src)" />
                <div class="fs-card-body">
                  <h4 class="fs-card-title">${s.name ?? s.title ?? "Untitled system"}</h4>
                  <p class="fs-card-desc">${s.description ?? ""}</p>
                  <p class="fs-card-meta">${s.contributor ?? ""}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            `).join("")}
          </div>
        </div>
      </details>
    `;
  }).join("")}
</div>`
```
